title: Solver-Free and Cost-Aware Online Scheduling of AI Data Center Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.22239v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI data centers receive computing tasks continuously, whereas solver-based optimization takes time to run and electricity is priced per settlement period. This paper bridges this timing gap through a solver-free online optimization rule inspired by dual decomposition. The rule assigns each task a start period upon arrival to optimize energy cost subject to operational constraints, shifting flexible tasks toward low-price periods while keeping high-priority tasks on schedule. Simulations on the A100 GPU trace (3,456 GPUs, 1,343 tasks) show that the proposed rule keeps GPU and CPU use within capacity while scheduling tasks at low cost. Compared with a multi-timescale optimization benchmark, it achieves a lower cost and, because it needs no solver, much less computation time.

translated_title: 无求解器且成本感知的AI数据中心任务在线调度
translated_abstract: AI数据中心持续不断地接收计算任务，而基于求解器的优化需要时间来运行，且电费按结算周期计价。本文通过一种受对偶分解启发的无求解器在线优化规则来弥合这一时间差。该规则在任务到达时为其分配一个开始周期，以便在满足运行约束的前提下优化能源成本，将灵活任务转移至低电价时段，同时保持高优先级任务按计划进行。在A100 GPU运行轨迹（3,456块GPU、1,343个任务）上的仿真表明，所提出的规则在将GPU和CPU使用率保持在容量范围内的同时，能够以低成本调度任务。与多时间尺度优化基准相比，该方法实现了更低的成本，并且由于无需求解器，计算时间大幅减少。
tldr: 本文提出一种受对偶分解启发的无求解器在线调度规则，在任务到达时即为其分配开始时段，在满足运行约束和高优先级任务按期执行的同时将灵活任务转移至低电价时段，从而以更低成本和更少计算时间优化AI数据中心的能源开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a solver-free online scheduling rule inspired by dual decomposition that assigns start periods to tasks upon arrival, shifting flexible tasks toward low-price periods while keeping high-priority tasks on schedule, achieving lower energy costs with much less computation time than multi-timescale optimization benchmarks.
